related_questions.question: How do I figure out my taxable income?
related_questions.snippet: In short, taxable income is equal to adjusted gross income (AGI) minus standard or itemized deductions. Here is a slightly more detailed formula: Taxable income = gross income - (nontaxable income + above-the-line deductions + standard deduction or itemized deductions).
